summary: `gyomu-schema` defines the canonical schema models and data structures for the Gyomu system, providing robust Pydantic-based models for Python AST and code analysis, package structure analysis, conceptual modeling, error handling, and configuration management.
responsibilities: Define canonical schema models and data structures for Python code analysis, AST elements, and metadata.
Provide models and structures for package analysis, dependencies, and architectural concepts.
Define application error types, operational error phases, and automated retry/recovery strategies.
Manage configuration settings and options for system execution, analysis, and loaders.
Provide utility functions for file system operations, project snapshots, and object serialization.

capabilities.name: Python AST and Code Analysis Schemas
capabilities.description: Defines schema models representing Python AST expressions, statements, types, and code structures for analysis.

capabilities.name: Package and Concept Modeling
capabilities.description: Provides comprehensive schema definitions for package analysis, dependency tracking, directory facts, and capability and package concepts.

capabilities.name: Error Handling and Retry Strategies
capabilities.description: Defines application-level error handling classes, operational phases, domain-specific errors, and retry strategies.

capabilities.name: Configuration and Process Options
capabilities.description: Defines configuration options and parameters for system processes, code analysis, LLM execution, and loaders.

capabilities.name: System Utilities and File Management
capabilities.description: Provides utilities for file system management, project and file snapshots, serialization, execution timing, and asynchronous/synchronous execution wrapping.

design_decisions: Built on Pydantic for rigorous data validation, schema modeling, and type safety across all domain objects.
Organizes codebase into specialized sub-packages separating Python language constructs, metadata, configuration, error management, and utilities.
Employs functional result types and protocols to support robust error handling, synchronization, and retry workflows.
usage_guidance: Use the schema models in `gyomu_schema.schemas` to construct, validate, and serialize Python code analyses, AST representations, and project snapshots.
Utilize `gyomu_schema.error` and associated retry strategies for consistent application error management and recovery.
Configure system processes and analysis options using the options defined in `gyomu_schema.option` and `gyomu_schema.config`.
Leverage utility functions in `gyomu_schema.utility` for serialization, execution timing, and safe result wrapping.
